title.zh: US SEC follows CFTC in staff guidance for crypto
title.en: US SEC follows CFTC in staff guidance for crypto

current_state.zh: The SEC updated its crypto FAQs to clarify how federal securities laws may apply to certain digital assets and transactions, including issuer buybacks under the Howey test, following similar CFTC staff guidance and a failed Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act.
current_state.en: The SEC updated its crypto FAQs to clarify how federal securities laws may apply to certain digital assets and transactions, including issuer buybacks under the Howey test, following similar CFTC staff guidance and a failed Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act.
